purpose: Extend map-equivalent CPU lookahead coverage while separating state repair from parallel construction.
selection_rule: Top three local input directive-instance counts outside the existing six-circuit mainline, with all subckt model names present in the fixed architecture. No measured candidate runtime used in selection.
scope: Existing Koios inputs, all previously referenced in adjacent project metadata; not independent benchmarks. Input counts do not establish larger RR graphs than GEMM.
environment: Clean inherited VPR_CPU_* and VPR_HYBRID_* overrides using the frozen runner; enable only the declared lookahead controls. GPU and trace off; skip-same-partition off; both state fixes on for all three corrected arms. Capture actual environment and affinity.

preparation.geometry: Use fixed native 3D architecture; verify actual occupancy on both layers and record RR nodes/edges, grid size and packed blocks.
preparation.failure_policy: Retain unsupported, failed and timed-out inputs; no replacement based on speed. If width 100 is unroutable, record it and freeze a separately versioned common-width protocol before any timed comparison.
preparation.configuration_binding: Hash BLIF, architecture, packed netlist, placement, RR graph, map, binaries and runner before formal runs.

qualification.plain_endpoint: Compare same-ELF per_group with the old frozen per-group binary for map, route-body, CPD, wirelength and iterations. Failure blocks strict attribution and requires diagnosis, not candidate-specific tuning.
qualification.correctness: Require byte-equivalent map, native FULL and independent stock FULL/STA; log any route-body difference separately.
qualification.quality: For each corrected optimization require CPD and wirelength <=1.05 times fixed_serial and per_group controls. Report raw-stock comparisons separately; never hide stock illegality or repair costs.

execution.lane: One solver at a time; same eight physical cores on one NUMA node for every arm.
execution.exclusivity: Prefer exclusive reservation if available; otherwise explicitly label shared-host results and capture load/cgroup metadata.
execution.order: Use a frozen balanced rotation of the four arm orders across six layouts and three repeats; alternate cache-mode order. Pair by circuit/placement/repeat.
execution.cache: Identical pre-read for all arms; reuse one qualified byte-identical map. Rebuild means rebuild lookahead, not cold filesystem cache.
execution.limits: Use existing 900-second routing timeout per attempt; retain timeouts as failures and revisit only under a versioned protocol. Freeze a separate bounded pack/place timeout before preparing execution manifests.

secondary_comparison: stock -> pipeline is system-level, includes state fixes; all arms have eight routing workers.
aggregation: Median of paired time ratios for each layout; geometric mean across layouts within circuit, then equal weight across circuits. Publish all samples, quality failures and cache negative cases; no aggregate omitting failed members.
promotion_gate: All legality/map/QoR gates pass; rebuild process geometric mean >=1.03 over per_group, each circuit >=1.00, and no layout cache process median regression >3%. Otherwise report bounded applicability and leave defaults unchanged. This engineering rule is not statistical significance.
conditional_extension_not_in_144: Only after qualified eight-core results, 16-core per_group/pipeline rebuild on the same three circuits/two layouts/three repeats (36 runs). Interleave core-count blocks if making scaling claims.
remaining_launch_work: Verify binary hashes and endpoint behavior
Freeze pack/place commands and timeout, materialize runner-specific manifests
Prepare six layouts, check map/legality/QoR, then evaluate qualification
